[SWS_CM_80103] Init value for field elements
⌈
If less data than expected
shall be deserialized and the data to be deserialized belong to a Field, the init-
Value shall be used if it is defined. Otherwise the data shall be discarded and the
incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the ara::com implementation).
⌋
